columns.comment: Treasury FX deal id.

columns.name: month

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.name: cpty_id

columns.comment: FX Spot, FX Forward or FX Swap.

columns.name: product_id

columns.name: quote_currency

columns.name: is_unsettled_at_as_of

columns.comment: APAC treasury booking location of the deal (ISO-2).
columns.name: booking_country

comment: One row per client FX deal booked with SMBC APAC treasury from 1-Apr-2024 to 30-Sep-2026: product (FX spot, forward, swap), currency pair, direction, USD notional, margin and revenue, hedge vs trading purpose, tenor and value date, booking location. Notional and revenue are flows (additive). FX flows that clients route through other banks are visible in fact_payment_transaction (FX_FLOW_VIA_OTHER_BANK signals). Grain: one row per FX deal (deal_id).
